cardOverview.overviewText: The SBI Gold & More Credit Card is a value rewards card under SBI’s “Value & Savings” range. It offers Cash Points on everyday spends through the Shop & Smile program, redeemable for vouchers, merchandise, or cashback. The card supports contactless payments, add-on cards, EMI options, and utility bill payments

items.title: Discover Reward Points Redemption Options
items.subtitle: To explore the full range of redemption options for this card, download the SaveSage Club app now.
